The BSC ecology Carson was attacked and lost about $145,000. At present, the price of Carson tokens has dropped by 96%, and the attacker has exchanged the stolen assets for 600 BNB and transferred them to Tornado Cash. The attacker repeatedly called the swapExactTokensForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens function in the 0x2bdf...341a contract (not open-source) through flash loans, swapped for BUSD and burned Carson in the pair, then repeatedly inflated the price of Carson for profit.

Carson DeFi was exploited on BNB Chain on July 26, 2023, for approximately $150,000, through flash-loan-assisted price manipulation targeting a custom AMM pool. The attacker skewed the pool's price using large BUSDT flash loans, repeated swaps, and extracted value via unsafe fee-on-transfer token handling. Unsafe handling of a fee-on-transfer token in a custom, closed-source AMM pool allowed price and reserve distortion. The AMM pool's reserve and pricing logic failed to account for the deflationary mechanics of Carson, enabling manipulation with flash-loan-amplified liquidity.
